D: Kermit and the gang go to New York to put on a Broadway show.
P: Serve dessert at Kermit and Piggy's wedding.
S: Twice-fried chips tossed with oregano, lemon zest and crumbled feta
Hand-cut chips double-fried, tossed while hot with dried oregano, lemon zest and crumbled feta, Greek diner style.
Buttered white bread with Dijon and sliced cheddar, griddled until golden
Grilled cheese sandwiches with cheddar and a little Dijon, griddled in butter, cut into soldiers.
Fozzie tries to hibernate in the woods, and a bear needs supplies

Crunchy cornflakes coated in bubbling honey butter, baked in paper cases until golden and set. Melt 90g butter with 80g sugar and 2 tbsp honey and bubble for 1 minute until frothy. Pour over 4 cups cornflakes and stir until coated. Spoon into 20 paper patty cases on a tray. Bake at 150C for 10 minutes until golden, then cool completely so they set crunchy.
M: Triple-decker toasted club with turkey, bacon, lettuce, tomato and mayo
Three slices of toast: turkey, bacon, lettuce, tomato and mayo, pinned and cut into triangles, chips on the side.
Pete's big Greek salad with souvlaki
Pete's diner, big tomato, big olives, very Pete

Chunky tomato, cucumber, capsicum, kalamatas and a slab of feta with oregano, served with grilled lemon chicken skewers. Marinate 600g diced chicken thigh in 3 tbsp olive oil, lemon juice, 2 garlic cloves and 1 tsp dried oregano for 30 minutes, thread onto 8 skewers and grill 10 minutes, turning. Cut 4 tomatoes, 1 cucumber, 1 green capsicum and half a red onion into chunks. Add 100g kalamatas, top with a 200g slab of feta, sprinkle oregano and dress with oil and red wine vinegar.
W: Two-layer butter cake with pink and green buttercream flowers
Two layers of vanilla butter cake sandwiched and covered in Swiss meringue buttercream, half tinted pink and half green, piped flowers.
K: Banana, Greek yogurt, milk and honey blended thick with ice

Greek yoghurt blended with milk, honey, banana and ice into a thick frothy shake with a sprinkle of cinnamon. Peel and slice 2 ripe bananas. Blend with 300g Greek yoghurt, 400ml cold milk, 3 tbsp honey and 1 cup ice for 45 seconds until thick and frothy. Taste and add a little more honey if needed. Pour into 4 tall glasses, drizzle each with a little more honey and dust with ground cinnamon. Serve with straws.

lines: Please do not feed the frog

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into chips.
Fry in 140C oil until soft but pale, then drain.
Fry again in 185C oil until golden and crisp.
Toss while hot with oregano, lemon zest, salt and crumbled feta. Squeeze the lemon over just before serving.
Spread the bread with Dijon and fill with cheddar.
Butter the outsides and griddle over medium heat until golden and melted, turning once.
Cut into soldiers.
Grill the bacon until crisp.
Toast the bread.
Layer turkey, bacon, lettuce, sliced tomato and mayo across three slices for each sandwich.
Pin with toothpicks, cut into triangles and serve with potato chips.
Heat the oven to 175C and line two tins. Beat the butter and sugar until pale.
Add the eggs, fold in the flour and divide between the tins.
Bake until a skewer comes out clean.
Cool the cakes completely.
Beat the icing butter with the icing sugar, split in half and tint one half pink and one half green.
Ice the cakes and pipe flowers.
Peel and slice the bananas.
Blend with the yoghurt, milk, some of the honey and the ice until thick and frothy. Taste and add more honey if needed.
Pour into tall glasses, drizzle with honey and dust with cinnamon.

s.note: Twice-fried chips tossed with oregano, lemon zest and crumbled feta
s.how: Cut 1kg potatoes into chips and fry twice, first at 140C, then at 185C. Toss while hot with 1 tsp dried oregano, the zest of a lemon, salt and 100g crumbled feta. Squeeze the lemon over just before serving.

s.note: Buttered white bread with Dijon and sliced cheddar, griddled until golden
s.how: Spread 8 slices white bread with Dijon and fill with 200g sliced cheddar. Butter the outsides with 40g butter and griddle over medium heat for 3 minutes a side until golden and melted. Cut into soldiers.

m.note: Triple-decker toasted club with turkey, bacon, lettuce, tomato and mayo
m.how: Grill 8 rashers of bacon. Toast 12 slices bread. Layer 300g sliced turkey, bacon, lettuce and 2 sliced tomatoes with mayo across three slices for each sandwich. Pin with toothpicks and cut into triangles. Serve with potato chips.

w.note: Two-layer butter cake with pink and green buttercream flowers
w.how: Beat 200g butter and 200g sugar, add 4 eggs and fold in 200g self-raising flour. Bake in two tins at 175C for 25 minutes. Beat 250g butter with 400g icing sugar, split and tint half pink and half green. Ice and pipe flowers.

d.note: Banana, Greek yogurt, milk and honey blended thick with ice
d.how: Peel and slice 2 ripe bananas. Blend with 300g Greek yoghurt, 400ml cold milk, 3 tbsp honey and 1 cup ice for 45 seconds until thick and frothy. Taste and add a little more honey if needed. Pour into 4 tall glasses, drizzle each with a little more honey and dust with ground cinnamon. Serve with straws.
